LegacyRecordSnapshot.title: LegacyRecordSnapshot
LegacyRecordSnapshot.description: Complete UTF-8 source and SHA-256 of those same bytes. `hash` includes the frontmatter and BOM; it is not a body hash or a metadata revision.

StoreError.title: StoreError
StoreError.description: Internal error envelope. The existing IPC command still returns its original displayable error string; no read failure is replaced with empty content.

SelectedEntryProperties.title: SelectedEntryProperties
SelectedEntryProperties.description: Exact selected metadata from the same guarded record as Entry.authority. Compatible legacy fields never replace canonical presence or kind tags.

EditorSaveRefusal.title: EditorSaveRefusal
EditorSaveRefusal.description: Definite refusal before this fresh editor dispatch published an intent. Resolve errors retain their unknown/pending owner state; they cannot claim the earlier original operation was never applied.

expectedVersion.description: Optional stale-target expectation for dependent body transforms. It is descriptive CAS evidence, never authority. General editor saves omit it.
